About the job

Marketing Trainee – Fixed Term

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Industry: Consumer Health / Healthcare Products

Employment Type: Full-time, Fixed-term

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

About the Role

An established consumer health organization is seeking a Marketing Trainee to support the planning, execution, and monitoring of marketing initiatives for a leading skincare brand in Mexico.

This entry-level opportunity provides exposure to brand management, consumer insights, business analysis, media and digital campaigns, innovation, and cross-functional project coordination.

The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Support the development and execution of annual brand plans and marketing initiatives.

Prepare business reports, dashboards, presentations, and performance updates.

Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Proactive approach with a strong willingness to learn.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced English proficiency.
Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Resilience and ability to adapt to changing priorities.
Interest in consumer marketing, brand management, and the healthcare or consumer products sector.

description:
About the job

About The Role

Our Uber Advertising Sales team is looking for a Client Partner to help accelerate growth across Non-Endemic industries in Mexico.

In this role, you will partner with some of Mexico's largest and most recognized brands, owning the strategy and performance of your vertical from end to end. You'll have the opportunity to shape long-term partnerships, drive business growth, and operate with a high level of ownership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You will connect Uber's unique first-party mobility and delivery insights with your clients' marketing objectives. Beyond selling advertising solutions, you will develop data-driven strategies that help brands engage consumers during high-intent, real-world moments while delivering measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do


Drive strategic growth: Develop and execute advertising partnership strategies that support partner marketing objectives and consistently deliver against quarterly growth goals. 
Build executive relationships: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with Directors, VPs, C-level marketing leaders, and other key decision-makers across Mexico's leading organizations. 
Lead consultative conversations: Apply critical thinking and a consultative approach to solve complex business challenges, navigate stakeholder needs, and create mutually beneficial outcomes. 
Grow product adoption: Help clients maximize value across Uber's Mobility and Delivery advertising solutions by introducing new products and identifying opportunities that align with their business goals. 
Craft compelling narratives: Develop impactful client presentations and sales stories that demonstrate how Uber's data and advertising solutions can drive measurable results. 
Collaborate across teams: Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to share customer insights, influence product improvements, and help shape future Ads solutions. 
Contribute to team success: Support teammates, share best practices, and contribute to building a collaborative, high-performing Ads organization as the business continues to grow. 


Basic Qualifications


Experience in digital advertising or media sales, with an understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem and upper-funnel marketing strategies. 
Demonstrated ability to negotiate effectively and influence stakeholders across multiple levels of an organization. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data and insights to support recommendations, sales strategies, and business outcomes. 
Ability to translate complex products and capabilities into clear, compelling stories that address client business objectives. 


Preferred Qualifications


5+ years of experience in end-to-end digital advertising sales, including managing enterprise, large customer, or strategic accounts. 
Experience selling advertising solutions to large, sophisticated brands. 
Demonstrated success building executive-level relationships and developing strategic sales plans that create value for both clients and Uber. 
Strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to transform complex data into clear, actionable business opportunities. 
Excellent negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a focus on developing long-term partnerships. 
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing environment, adapting priorities while maintaining a focus on results. 
Excellent listening, communication, and relationship-building skills. Professional proficiency in both Spanish and English is required to collaborate with local partners and global cross-functional teams. 
Experience leading through influence, collaborating across teams, and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing team culture. 


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. description:
About the job

Working At Bitso
We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.
To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.
Your Purpose 
We're looking for a resourceful, analytical, and execution-obsessed B2B Growth Marketing Specialist to become the operational backbone of our marketing team. This is a hybrid role that spans demand generation, event operations, campaign execution, and marketing ops, all with a relentless focus on pipeline growth and efficiency.
You'll own programs end-to-end: from building the strategy and managing vendor relationships to tracking budgets, analyzing results, and iterating fast. Events are an important part of the mix, but so are ABM plays, content-driven lead gen, partner marketing, and everything in between.
We need someone who doesn't wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You use AI tools daily to multiply your output. You're as comfortable building a campaign report in HubSpot as you are negotiating a venue contract or writing a landing page brief. If you thrive in fast-paced, "do more with less" environments, this role is for you.
Reports To
Senior Marketing Manager for Bitso Business - Ingrid Carraro
Who You Are 

4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in roles that combined demand gen, events, and marketing ops.
A genuine growth mindset — you're metrics-driven, experiment-happy, and always looking for the next lever to pull.
Solid experience managing events and marketing budgets, vendor contracts, and multi-vendor logistics.
Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (Marketing Hub & CRM).
Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in spreadsheets, dashboards, and data. You make decisions with numbers, not gut feeling.
Heavy, daily user of AI tools: you already use AI to write, analyze, automate, and create. This is non-negotiable.
Exceptional organizational skills: you manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders without dropping balls.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Spanish.
Based in Mexico City with availability for occasional travel.
Nice-to-Have
Experience in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS B2B environments.
Familiarity with ABM platforms (Demandbase, 6sense, HubSpot ABM).
Experience with paid media management (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta).
Knowledge of SEO/SEM fundamentals and content marketing strategy.
Experience with analytics and BI tools (Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau).
Experience with event platforms (Whova, Cvent, others).

What You Will Do 

Event Marketing & Field Programs
Manage the end-to-end logistics of B2B marketing events: trade shows, hosted dinners, executive roundtables, webinars, virtual summits, and partner activations.
Source, negotiate, and manage external vendors (venues, A/V, catering, booth production, swag, event platforms) and own all related contracts and payments.
Build pre-event, during-event, and post-event engagement strategies to maximize pipeline impact from every event dollar spent.
Capture and repurpose event content (recordings, insights, testimonials) into downstream marketing assets.
Budget, Vendor & Project Management
Own and manage marketing budgets across events and campaigns: forecasting, PO tracking, invoice reconciliation, and ROI reporting.
Manage multiple vendor and agency relationships simultaneously, ensuring deliverables are on time, on budget, and on brand.
Maintain rigorous project management practices across all workstreams — timelines, briefs, status updates, and stakeholder alignment.
Marketing Operations & Analytics
Be able to manage workflows, lead scoring, email automation, campaign attribution, list segmentation, and reporting dashboards on HubSpot.
Ensure data hygiene across the CRM: proper UTM tagging, lead source tracking, duplicate management, and lifecycle stage accuracy.
Build and maintain performance dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into marketing's impact on pipeline and revenue.
Analyze campaign and channel performance to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to the team.
AI-Powered Productivity & Automation
Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Jasper, Notion AI, etc.) daily across the workflow — content drafting, data analysis, creative production, vendor research, reporting, and process automation.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to eliminate manual, repetitive work across marketing operations.
Stay on top of emerging AI-powered martech tools and proactively bring recommendations to the team.
Be a force multiplier — consistently deliver the output of a much larger team by working smarter with technology.
Content & Creative Collaboration
Collaborate with content and design teams (or lead directly when needed) to produce campaign assets: landing pages, emails, social content, one-pagers, presentations, and sales enablement materials.
Write clear, compelling briefs for creative and content requests, ensuring alignment with campaign goals and brand standards.
Support thought leadership efforts by coordinating webinar content, blog topics, and industry POV pieces with subject-matter experts
Cross-Functional Alignment
Work closely with Sales to ensure marketing programs/events are aligned with pipeline goals, territory plans, and target account lists.
Partner with Product Marketing to translate product narratives into demand gen campaigns and event messaging.
Provide regular performance updates and strategic recommendations to leadership.

Who We Are
With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.

description:
About the job

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

As a Revenue & Pricing Specialist, you will be part of our Revenue Management Team, where you will take commercial responsibility for assigned markets and help ensure business success through data-driven pricing, demand steering, forecasting, and market analysis. You will work closely with commercial, network planning, and business development teams to align revenue management strategies with overall business goals and objectives.

This role requires strong analytical thinking, business ownership, autonomy, resilience, and the ability to make decisions in a fast-paced and rapidly changing market environment

About The Role


Take commercial responsibility for assigned markets and steer them in the best possible way to ensure business success. 
Manage demand independently, with guidance from your Team Lead. 
Define pricing and revenue strategies based on current and historical demand patterns, competitor actions, and market conditions. 
Customize prices, inventory control, and demand forecasting based on specific demand situations. 
Monitor the impact of pricing decisions through customer bookings and conversion rates. 
Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor pricing to determine optimal pricing strategies for products and services. 
Act as the main point of contact with Country or Regional Commercial Teams within the department. 
Work closely with Network Planning, Business Development, and other internal teams to align revenue management strategies with broader business objectives. 
Participate actively in the further development of pricing systems. 
Take ownership of projects to optimize processes and support new features across the Revenue Management domain. 


About You


Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Business, Engineering, or a similar field. 
Experience in pricing, revenue management, commercial analytics, or related areas. 
Previous experience in similar industries is a plus. 
Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with a solid understanding of numbers and business performance. 
Good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel. 
Personal initiative, resilience, and a self-driven, goal-oriented working attitude. 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Ability to adapt quickly and effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing market environment. 
Fluency in English is required 


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer


 Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
 Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
 Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
 Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
 Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture — giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: SEO Content Optimizer
skills: SEO Content Optimizer
Content
Content Director

The SEO Content Optimizer leverages Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to produce and refine channel‑specific content: blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, Google Business Profile posts, brand development content, and social captions.

You’ll format, fact‑check, interlink, and polish AI outputs to meet our SEO, accessibility, and brand standards. This is an AI‑first, optimization role; ideal for someone with basic content writing and on‑page SEO knowledge who enjoys turning AI drafts into publication‑ready assets.
AI‑Enabled Content Production

Use Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to draft channel‑specific content (blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, landing pages, Google Business Profile posts, social captions, email snippets), then refine outputs to meet brand and SEO standards.
On‑Page Structure & SEO

Organize content with clear heading hierarchy (H1–H3), scannable paragraphs, bullet/numbered lists, tables when useful, and SEO elements including title tags, meta descriptions, URL slugs, and alt text, where applicable.
Image/Media Selection & Optimization
Source appropriate visuals from approved stock libraries or client assets; ensure image & content relevancy, alt text, and quality.
Internal Linking & Taxonomy

Implement and maintain interlinking across blogs, service pages, and location pages to support topical clusters (e.g., lawn care, landscaping, irrigation, hardscaping) and guide users toward pillar pages.
Editing & Quality Assurance

Audit AI output for accuracy, clarity, originality, brand voice, readability, and local relevance (services, service areas, seasonality). Resolve inconsistencies, remove fluff, and ensure compliance with checklists and tone guides.
Client Voice & Brand Fidelity

Tailor content to each client’s tone, offers, certifications, and service territories; accurately reflect nuances of the lawn & landscape niche (seasonal tasks, regional considerations, safety and licensing notes).
SOP Adherence & Improvement
Follow Green Marketing’s standard operating procedures and checklists consistently; document gaps and propose updates to prompts, templates, and knowledge base to improve throughput and quality.
Documentation & Asset Management
Maintain organized records of prompts, drafts, publishing statuses, image sources/attributions, and final URLs; keep content calendars and task boards up to date.
Basic understanding of on‑page SEO (title/meta, headings, internal links, alt text, URL slugs).
Basic understanding of AI tools (prompting, refining outputs, responsible use).
Communication skills: clear writing, concise edits, and professional client‑facing notes.
Strong attention to detail: consistency, grammar, brand voice, and checklist discipline.
Ability to follow SOPs and hit deadlines across multiple client accounts.
Comfortable using spreadsheets/task boards (content calendars, status tracking).
This is a fully remote position. Team members must maintain a professional, distraction‑free workspace and reliable connectivity to collaborate and deliver work on schedule.
Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), Monday–Friday.
Be available for stand‑ups, reviews, and client‑related meetings during these hours (observing ET, including Daylight Saving shifts).
Timeliness: 100% on‑time delivery; 0 overdue tasks per month.
SOP Adherence: ≥ 98% checklist compliance across formatting, metadata, interlinking, accessibility, and publishing steps.
Quality / Error Rate: ≤ 2 minor issues per 10 assets; 0 critical errors (e.g., incorrect client details, broken links, image licensing issues).
First‑Pass Approval: ≥ 90% “ready to publish” on initial submission.
Interlinking Coverage: 100% of eligible assets include required internal links per content brief/topic cluster.
Accessibility Completeness: Alt text on 100% of images; correct heading order on 100% of pages.
Revision Efficiency: Average 1.5 revision cycles per asset before final approval.
Throughput: Meets monthly cadence defined in the content plan (blogs, service/location pages, GBP posts, social captions).
Communication SLAs: Responds to team/client comments within working hours on the same business day.
Base Salary: $1,200 per month (USD).
PTO: Generous paid time off, including mental health days.
Additional details on holidays and accruals provided at offer stage.

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Specialist to help build, execute, and continuously improve the campaigns that power AlertMedia's marketing engine. You'll work hands-on in Marketo and Salesforce to launch email and nurture programs, keep our CRM and marketing automation systems clean and connected, and partner with enrichment and workflow tools like Clay and Wrike to bring more automation and consistency to how the team operates. This role suits someone who is equal parts builder and troubleshooter: comfortable in the technical weeds of a platform, but just as comfortable explaining a deliverability issue or a tracking gap to a non-technical stakeholder. 

What you get to every day:  

Email & Campaign Execution 


Own the email process, through QA and delivery, working directly with content, creative, events, lifecycle, customer marketing, product marketing and demand generation to build branded emails that are sent with the highest quality and efficacy. 
Build, QA, deploy, and optimize email campaigns end to end in Marketo, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, deliverability checks, and scheduling. 
Work collaboratively with email stakeholders to QA every send using Litmus and AlertMedia's email build standards (link accuracy, UTM parameters, tracking, and rendering) before it goes live. 
Build and maintain campaign infrastructure, including workflows, templates, and smart campaigns, to enable scale and consistency across marketing. 
Create, maintain, and audit sales email sequences in Outreach. 
Serve as project manager driving alignment and approvals with key stakeholder for all email campaigns 


Marketing Operations & CRM Support 


Manage ongoing operational tasks across Marketo and Salesforce, including list management, lead routing support, form and workflow maintenance, and data hygiene. 
Maintain data quality on form fields (validation rules, required fields, duplicate handling) to protect lead database integrity. 
Partner with web and development teams to troubleshoot tracking discrepancies between Marketo tracking and form submission data. 
Regularly audit and optimize data flow between Marketo programs and Salesforce campaigns, ensuring campaign member status mapping is accurate. 
Maintain naming conventions and folder structures for Marketo programs to support scalable reporting across marketing. 


Webinar & Event Program Support 


Coordinate webinar logistics across marketing and other departments, including registration setup, reminder and follow-up sequences, platform configuration, and post-event lead handoff. 
Build and maintain Marketo programs (webinars, in-person events, virtual conferences) using standardized program templates to ensure consistent tracking across all event types. 
Ensure Salesforce campaigns are set up correctly, so funnel tracking and attribution are correct. 
Set up and QA registration and confirmation emails, calendar invites, and reminder or follow-up sends tied to event and webinar programs. 
Ensure program success flags and channel and program tagging align with attribution models for accurate marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced reporting. 


Reporting, Process & Documentation 


Pull and maintain reporting on email and nurture campaign performance (opens, clicks, conversions, pipeline influence), surfacing insights, flagging anomalies, and communicating deliverability and list-quality issues clearly to non-analytical stakeholders. 
Use those insights to inform A/B testing and continuous optimization of engagement, conversion, and ROI working in close collaboration with the Lifecycle Marketing Manager. 
Build and maintain repeatable processes and documentation so campaigns launch consistently, and the team can scale execution without sacrificing quality. 
Own end-to-end execution of global campaigns, ensuring scalable, repeatable program delivery across email, paid search, webinars, events, and account-based marketing. 
Coordinate email localization efforts with EMEA reviewers as well. 


Automation & Compliance 


Pilot AI-aware patterns and automation (for example, prompt-driven builds) within the email workflow, and partner with GTM Engineering to replace manual steps. 
Support enrichment workflows in Clay to improve data quality and routing accuracy. 
Understand and monitor compliance and database hygiene tasks including GDPR, opt-in management, unsubscribes, and invalid or suspended records. 


What you bring to the role:


2-3 years of experience in a marketing operations, campaign management, demand generation, or email marketing role, ideally at a B2B technology company. 
Must have hands-on experience with Marketo. 
Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or other CRM platforms to build emails, forms, lists, workflows, smart campaigns, and dynamic content. 
Strong attention to detail and a QA mindset — you catch broken links, mis-segmented sends, and tracking gaps before they go live. 
Experience with audience segmentation, list hygiene, and email deliverability at scale.
Solid organizational and project -management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines. 
Ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product marketing, and event teams to keep multi-stakeholder programs on track, often on tight cycles. 
Reporting and analytics literacy — comfortable pulling campaign metrics and translating them into clear, actionable summaries. 
Self-starter who can own recurring operational work independently and reliably from start to finish. 
The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced challenging environment.
Exceptional English communication skills  (oral and written).


Nice to have:


Familiarity with enrichment, data, or account-based marketing tooling (such as Clay) and analytics tools. 
HTML/CSS skills for troubleshooting email. 
Experience supporting a high-volume and fast-paced marketing team. 
An affinity for learning complex, highly technical products and strong technical aptitude, generally.

title: Accounting Coordinator
description:
About the job

Accounting Coordinator




Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of the organization’s financial information by managing and overseeing accounting processes, preparing financial reports, and complying with applicable accounting standards and principles. The position is responsible for preparing and analyzing daily, weekly, and monthly accounting reports, as well as for generating reliable financial information to support decision-making.




Requirements:




• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Accounting, Finance, Financial Management, or a related field. Specialization or graduate studies in accounting and finance are preferred.

• Experience: At least 4 years of experience in supervisory or managerial roles in accounting and finance, leading work teams. Verifiable experience in the accounting and financial management of multiple legal entities in Mexico and Latin America.

• Schedule availability: Full-time, with availability to work in person at corporate offices.

• Willingness to travel: Occasional, as needed by the business.

• English proficiency: Advanced, with the ability to communicate effectively in professional and corporate settings.

• Technical Knowledge and Skills:

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, data analysis, and macros).

• Experience with financial ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365). SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms will be considered equivalent.

• Extensive knowledge and experience in the application of automated accounting systems and financial management tools.

• Solid knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and US GAAP.

 Up-to-date knowledge of applicable tax and regulatory legislation in Mexico.

• Experience in financial consolidation, budgeting, financial forecasting, profitability analysis, and internal control.

• Ability to interpret complex financial information and generate analyses that support strategic decision-making.




Main Responsibilities:




• Develop and maintain dynamic financial models to support the evaluation of potential contracts, business opportunities, and strategic decision-making.

• Manage and oversee the accounts receivable portfolio, ensuring the timely collection of balances and proper credit risk management.

• Lead financial forecasting, budgeting, and revenue projection processes for Mexico and Latin America, coordinating inputs from the Sales, Marketing, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Service departments.

• Monitor the financial performance of contracts, ensuring timely billing in accordance with contractual milestones and established payment terms.

• Develop and manage cash flow projections to ensure adequate financial planning and operational liquidity.




We offer a comprehensive benefits package and a salary commensurate with experience.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the job

 A little bit about us:




We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.




About the team:




We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack. 
Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.

Our Payments product in Mexico has been growing at an incredible pace over the past few years. This product pillar’s mission is to enable companies in Mexico to access Variable Recurring Payments (VRP) through Account-to-Account (A2A) rails. This solves a critical need in the country, where thousands of businesses still struggle to collect recurring payments from their users in a scalable and automated way.

Our customers are any businesses that need to collect recurring payments — from loan repayments and subscriptions to utility bills. We provide them access to Direct Debit in Mexico (Domiciliación Bancaria) through an advanced API-based product that allows them to manage consents, orchestrate collections intelligently, and optimize their operations. The result: lower payment processing costs, fewer operational headaches, and smoother customer experiences.

This product demands not only strong technical expertise, but also an operations-first mindset to continuously improve scalability, reliability, and efficiency as we grow.

About the job

Ciudad de México (Híbrido/Remoto)

Full-time | Entry Level

$15,000 MXN mensuales de sueldo base + comisiones sin tope




Sobre Good Traffic




Good Traffic es la empresa detrás de los autos de rideshare con vehicle wraps, la plataforma de publicidad exterior construida sobre la red de rideshare mundial. Convertimos vehículos normales en espectaculares en movimiento — combinando car wrapping con tecnología de geolocalización y medición de impresiones para darle a las marcas más grandes del mundo un nuevo tipo de inventario de medios: branding premium en movimiento. Somos un equipo pequeño y ágil, y cada persona que se une tiene un impacto real en qué tan rápido crecemos.




Empieza tu carrera en ventas B2B con Good Traffic.




Como SDR serás el primer punto de contacto entre nuestra marca y los anunciantes que podrían beneficiarse de nuestro formato de vehículos wrapeados. No necesitas años de experiencia — solo hustle, curiosidad y ganas de aprender rápido. Vas a trabajar de cerca con nuestro equipo de ventas y marketing para encontrar a los prospectos correctos, iniciar conversaciones y agendar reuniones que se conviertan en relaciones reales con clientes.




Tu rol en el equipo




● Prospección 100% outbound hacia anunciantes potenciales que tú mismo identifiques.

● Entender las necesidades de los anunciantes potenciales e identificar cómo nuestro formato encaja con sus objetivos de marketing.

● Mantener un seguimiento cercano de tu propia actividad y números de pipeline.

● Planear, gestionar y organizar tu prospección y seguimientos en el CRM.

● Asegurarte de que cada lead e interacción quede correctamente registrado.

● Mapear y prospectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en marcas de CPG, retail, enterprise, etc.




¿Qué vas a hacer?




● Identificar y prospectar activamente nuevos clientes potenciales mediante investigación, mapeo de mercado y herramientas de ventas.

About the job

Role Description 

The ServiceNow PreSales Consultant is a full-time remote role focused on supporting customers and prospects throughout the pre-sales cycle. In this role, the consultant collaborates with sales teams to understand client needs, designs tailored ServiceNow solutions, and develops compelling proposals, presentations, and demonstrations. Day-to-day responsibilities include gathering and analyzing requirements, preparing solution architectures and value propositions, and participating in discovery workshops and technical discussions. The consultant works closely with delivery teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible and aligned with best practices, while contributing to RFP responses, supporting proof-of-concept initiatives, and staying current on ServiceNow capabilities and industry trends.

Relevant ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CSA, CIS in one or more modules) and prior experience in enterprise SaaS or digital transformation initiatives are a plus.




Company Description 

CoreX Corp is a global consultancy founded in 2023 by leaders in the ServiceNow ecosystem, dedicated to making enterprise transformation feel like momentum rather than friction. The company helps organizations unlock the full potential of the Now Platform through deep domain expertise, practical functional insight, and context-aware automation. CoreX serves clients across industries, tailoring solutions to address specific challenges, drive measurable impact, ensure compliance, and optimize outcomes. With roots in the ServiceNow ecosystem going back to 2009 and a team that includes former ServiceNow executives, CoreX offers extensive platform expertise supported by hundreds of certifications to enable enterprise-wide transformation.

Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an AI Quality Analyst - English to work on a full-time basis. You will evaluate a new personalization feature for an AI model by assessing how well it integrates information from past conversations, email, search, and activity to deliver relevant responses. This role requires a combination of creative prompt design and analytical evaluation of AI-generated content.




Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate the quality of personalized responses from an AI model using your own personal experiences as context.

• Design creative, multi-turn prompts that test the model’s ability to integrate personal data sources accurately.

• Assess model responses for grounding, integration, and helpfulness, identifying incorrect personalization or forced connections.

• Review side-by-side comparisons of AI responses to detect subtle differences in relevance and accuracy.

• Provide detailed feedback on model behavior to improve personalization performance.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• English proficiency with a high degree of competence in reading and writing.

• Experience in prompt engineering or designing test cases for AI models.

• Ability to analyze nuanced and ambiguous AI responses with analytical rigor.

• Familiarity with personalization concepts and evaluation metrics in AI systems.

• Attention to detail to identify subtle discrepancies in model outputs.

• Willingness to use your primary personal Google account and enable personal data sources for assessment.

• Full-time availability in your local time zone to support a global, 24-hour operations team.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the development of advanced AI systems that deliver measurable business impact.

About the job

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Business Development Associate

Introduction to the Team

You'll be at the front line of Expedia Group's growth, driving hotel partner acquisition in a competitive market. Working from a pipeline of leads and opportunities, you'll manage deals from first contact through to close — building your commercial skills in a structured, high-energy sales environment.

In This Role, You Will

Pipeline & Territory


Build and manage a pipeline of acquisition opportunities across large regional and/or tertiary markets

Create opportunities through prospecting meetings, fact-finding calls, and exploratory conversations


Customer Understanding


Develop a working knowledge of each prospect's business — their goals, key decision-makers, competitive context, and industry dynamics
Use CRM tools to research and map customer relationships before engaging


Business Acumen

Begin to assess the cost, benefit, and risk of potential solutions
Build awareness of how your work fits into the broader organization and its financial impact

Build solid knowledge of Expedia Group's products, technologies, and offerings
Develop understanding of competitor products to sharpen your pitch
Analyze historical sales data to identify trends and quantify opportunities within your territory

Fluent in English and the local language(s) of your market

Eager to learn sales techniques and grow fast in a commercial role


How You'll Grow

This role is designed as a launchpad. You'll receive structured coaching, work alongside experienced sales professionals, and quickly develop the skills to own a territory independently.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

From agile microloans for quick capital injections to expansive term loans for long-term strategies, our diverse portfolio ensures that we have the right financial tools to support your journey whether you are scaling up or solidifying your market position.




Job Summary




The Customer Service Associate is responsible for providing excellent customer support by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring customer satisfaction. This role involves responding to customer inquiries via various channels (phone, email, chat), handling product or service-related issues, and maintaining a positive and professional attitude. The Customer Service Associate works closely with other departments to ensure that customers receive timely and accurate assistance. This position requires strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




Customer Support & Issue Resolution:

Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, or in person, providing timely and effective solutions to resolve issues.
Handle customer complaints, concerns, and inquiries with professionalism, ensuring a positive experience throughout the interaction.
Troubleshoot and resolve product or service issues by identifying the root cause and providing appropriate solutions or escalation when necessary.

Product & Service Knowledge:

Maintain a thorough understanding of the company's products, services, policies, and procedures to assist customers accurately.
Stay updated on new product releases, features, and company updates to effectively address customer inquiries and promote relevant offerings.
Educate customers on product usage, troubleshooting steps, and self-service options, ensuring they maximize the benefits of the company's products or services.

Customer Relationship Management:

Build and maintain strong relationships with customers by demonstrating empathy, professionalism, and responsiveness in every interaction.
Record and update customer interactions and inquiries in the company’s CRM system to track issue resolution and identify potential areas for improvement.
Follow up with customers to ensure issues are fully resolved and their expectations are met.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Support:

Collaborate with other departments (e.g., sales, technical support, billing) to resolve complex customer issues or escalate matters as needed.
Communicate customer feedback to internal teams to help improve products, services, or processes based on customer input.
Assist in team efforts to improve the overall customer experience by providing insights or suggestions for process improvement.

Compliance & Documentation:

Ensure that all customer interactions adhere to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all customer interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Provide reports on common customer issues and feedback to identify areas for product or service improvements.

Customer Satisfaction & Retention:

Work to meet and exceed customer service targets, including response times, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores.
Promote customer retention by resolving issues efficiently and building long-term relationships with clients.
Offer suggestions for additional products or services that align with customer needs and improve their overall experience.

Qualifications (Knowledge/Skills/Abilities/Experience) 

Education:

High school diploma or equivalent required. A bachelor's degree in a related field is a plus but not required.

Experience:

Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in customer service or a related field, preferably in retail, hospitality, or a service-oriented environment.
Experience using customer service software, CRM systems, or other support tools is preferred.

Skills/Abilities:

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage with customers professionally and clearly.
Excellent proficiency in English & Spanish.
Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a customer-centric approach to addressing inquiries and issues.
Ability to manage multiple customer interactions simultaneously while maintaining high-quality service.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to demonstrate empathy, patience, and professionalism in challenging situations.
Proficiency in using computer systems and customer service tools, including Microsoft Office Suite and CRM systems.

Knowledge:

Familiarity with customer service principles and best practices, including troubleshooting techniques and customer issue resolution.
Understanding of the company’s products, services, and industry to provide knowledgeable assistance to customers.

Personal Attributes:

Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering exceptional service and building positive relationships with clients.
Detail-oriented, with a commitment to accuracy and thoroughness in handling customer inquiries.
Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to adjust to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Team player, with a collaborative attitude and willingness to support colleagues and contribute to overall team success.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:
We are searching for an Senior Specialist Employee Services to join the Global Business Services (GBS) People & Culture (P&C) team. In this role, the Senior Specialist provides efficient and highly informative first point-of-contact service to all employees, their managers and business partners. 
 
Focused on a seamless customer experience and great customer care, the Senior Specialist uses information from multiple systems and resources to respond to inquiries; provides navigational support to employees on self-service/HR tools such as Workday and ServiceNow and routing/escalating inquiries for advanced support. Using the case management system, the Senior Specialist accurately processes, records, closes or escalates transactions in accordance with established service level agreements. This role collects required information or back-up documentation from employees or external customers. This includes tactfully asking customers probing questions to establish context and ensure the solutions offered or the escalation path is appropriate and most likely to succeed. 
 
The Senior Specialist role provides feedback internally, proposing new and effective ways to resolve problems and improve productivity (i.e., continuous improvement efforts), while maintaining broad knowledge of policies, procedures, and resources.

Analyze and resolve different types of requests from employees or clients.
Handle inbound requests via phone, email, the HR-Portal, or other access channels. 
Perform individual employee data transactions and data-entry in Workday and other systems. 
Troubleshoot payroll and time off inquiries, recalculations, employment verifications (VOE/VOIs), direct deposit setups, pay and tax document re-issues, data updates, etc.

Ensure completeness of case notes, aligning with company and audit expectations.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field
Fluent in English 
Experience with Human Resources administrative or related experience required, preferably with supervisory responsibilities from a global entertainment environment.

How We Get Things Done…

Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México y Colombia para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

About the job

Our client is a fast-growing digital healthcare company that helps individuals access affordable telehealth services and prescription treatments through a seamless online experience. Focused on delivering exceptional customer care, the company combines technology, licensed medical professionals, and personalized support to guide customers throughout their wellness journey.

As the company continues to grow, they are seeking a Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist to support prospective customers through consultative, phone-based sales conversations and help qualified individuals confidently move through the enrollment process.




Role Overview

The Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist will be responsible for handling inbound phone calls from prospective customers interested in the company's telehealth services and prescription treatment options.

The Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist will build rapport, understand customer needs and concerns, address objections, explain the purchasing process, and guide qualified prospects toward enrollment. This is a consultative sales role that requires balancing conversion goals with an empathetic, customer-first approach.

This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, skilled at closing warm inbound opportunities, and comfortable navigating sensitive health and wellness conversations with professionalism and empathy.




Location

Fully Remote | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM PST




Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Conversion

Handle inbound sales calls from prospective customers interested in the company's services.
Guide qualified prospects through the enrollment and purchasing process.
Identify customer needs, motivations, concerns, and buying signals during conversations.
Confidently move qualified opportunities toward a successful close.
Answer non-clinical questions regarding pricing, enrollment, promotions, timelines, and the purchasing process.
Explain available promotions, discounts, and special offers according to company guidelines.
Follow up with interested prospects when additional communication is appropriate.
Maintain a consultative approach focused on helping customers make informed purchasing decisions.




Objection Handling & Customer Experience

Build rapport and establish trust quickly during inbound conversations.
Use active listening to understand customer concerns and motivations.
Address objections related to pricing, enrollment, processes, and other non-clinical concerns.
Help customers work through hesitation without relying on high-pressure sales tactics.
Maintain empathy and professionalism during sensitive conversations related to health and wellness.
Create a positive customer experience that supports both conversion and long-term customer retention.




Compliance & Customer Information

Protect confidential customer information and follow HIPAA requirements.
Maintain appropriate boundaries between sales conversations and clinical guidance.
Escalate medical and clinical questions to licensed healthcare professionals according to established procedures.
Follow company guidelines regarding approved customer communications and information.
Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions.




CRM & Pipeline Management

Manage customer interactions and sales activities within the company's CRM platform.
Maintain detailed and accurate notes for customer conversations.
Keep prospect information, follow-up activities, and customer status up to date.
Track interested prospects and ensure appropriate follow-up occurs.
Maintain organized customer records throughout the enrollment process.




Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Collaborate with internal teams to provide a smooth customer experience.
Participate in ongoing sales coaching, quality assurance reviews, and product training.
Apply coaching and feedback to improve sales conversations and conversion performance.
Quickly develop strong knowledge of the company's products, promotions, processes, and approved customer information.
Continuously improve objection handling, active listening, and consultative sales techniques.




Qualifications

Experience

2+ years of experience in inbound sales, inside sales, consultative sales, or a high-performing customer-facing role.
Proven experience closing warm inbound sales opportunities.
Experience handling objections and converting interested prospects into customers.
Experience managing customer conversations through structured sales processes.
Customer service experience is strongly preferred.
Experience using CRM platforms to document customer interactions and sales activity.




Skills

Strong phone-based sales and consultative selling skills.
Strong active listening skills with the ability to understand customer needs and concerns.
Ability to quickly establish rapport and trust with prospective customers.
Strong objection-handling and closing abilities.
High emotional intelligence and ability to navigate sensitive conversations professionally.
Ability to balance customer experience with sales and conversion objectives.
Experience using CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar systems.
Strong attention to detail when documenting customer conversations and follow-up activities.
Ability to quickly learn new products, processes, systems, and workflows.
Ability to follow structured sales, compliance, and escalation procedures.




What Success Looks Like

Qualified inbound opportunities consistently convert into completed enrollments and customers.
Prospects receive an empathetic, consultative, and professional sales experience.
Customer objections are effectively addressed without relying on high-pressure selling.
Rapport and trust are established quickly during inbound conversations.
Customer interactions and follow-up activities are accurately documented within the CRM.
Customer information is protected and compliance procedures are consistently followed.
Product and process knowledge develops quickly and is applied effectively during customer conversations.
Coaching and quality feedback lead to continuous improvements in sales effectiveness.
Sales goals are achieved while maintaining a strong customer experience.




Opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to combine consultative sales with meaningful customer engagement in a growing digital healthcare environment. As the Sales & Customer Engagement Specialist, you will help prospective customers navigate the enrollment process, address concerns, and confidently make informed purchasing decisions.

About the job

Ilir Sela started Slice with the belief that local pizzerias deserve all of the advantages of major franchises without compromising their independence. Starting with his family’s pizzerias, we now empower over tens of thousands of restaurants with the technology, services, and collective power that owners need to better serve their digitally minded customers and build lasting businesses. We’re growing and adding more talent to help fulfil this valuable mission. That’s where you come in.

The Challenge to Solve

Slice CRM sits at a genuinely unusual intersection: two audiences (consumers and shop owners), four active channels (email, push, in-app, and SMS), and a mission (More Bigger Orders) that requires both sides of the equation to work. The consumer side demands lifecycle automation that drives repeat purchase and habit formation. The shop owner side is newer territory: an SMS-first program built to educate and engage independent operators, giving them the ability to compete with large franchise models. The foundation is being built, and we need someone who can assist in constructing it while running the programs that depend on it.

The Role

As CRM Lead, you'll be hands-on. Your primary domain is Braze (Canvas flows, segmentation, campaign architecture, subscription group logic), and you'll operate at the intersection of CRM and data, collaborating with technical partners on the infrastructure that unlocks the next generation of automation. You'll own campaign execution, QA, and platform hygiene while also contributing to how we sequence and evolve our broader CRM strategy across both audiences.

The Team

You'll join a small, high-output CRM team working across B2C and B2B audiences in close partnership with marketing, data and engineering. Visibility is high. CRM is a priority at the leadership level, and your work will be seen.

The Winning Recipe 

We're Looking For Someone Equally Comfortable As The Architect And The Builder, Someone Who Can Hold The Strategic Picture While Doing Precise, Reliable Execution Work In Braze. These Are The Core Competencies


3–5 years in marketing ops, CRM, or growth ops, ideally in a multi-channel B2C and B2B environment with transactional or marketplace dynamics
Deep Braze experience: Canvas flows, segmentation, content blocks, subscription groups, and campaign QA. You've maintained these systems, not just used them
Technical fluency: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and Liquid personalization for dynamic content in emails and messaging
Comfort operating in a data-dependency environment. You can build toward clean systems from imperfect starting points and sequence work when prerequisites are still in progress
Familiarity with incrementality thinking: holdout groups, control logic, and understanding the difference between correlation and lift
Communication: Fluent written and verbal English skills, with the ability to communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences
Bonus: experience building an SMS program from the ground up


The Extras

Working at Slice comes with a comprehensive set of benefits, but here are some of the unexpected highlights:


Premium healthcare, dental, and optical coverage
25 days PTO
Wellbeing stipend

About the job

QUIÉNES SOMOS 

Con una red inigualable en 220 países y territorios, DHL Express es el proveedor líder mundial de servicios de mensajería Express internacional y está clasificado entre los Mejores Lugares para Trabajar del Mundo por Great Place to Work y la revista Fortune. En DHL, tenemos la misión de conectar a las personas y mejorar vidas. Esta misión nos impulsa a tener un impacto positivo en nuestro negocio, en los demás y en las comunidades globales a las que servimos.

LO QUE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO 

DHL Express México está buscando un Director de Servicio a Clientes para trabajar dentro el área de Servicio a Clientes – Backline.

OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO:

Garantizar que el equipo de Backline gestione, preserve y fortalezca la relación con los clientes, transformando una experiencia negativa en una positiva mediante una atención cordial y empática, enfocada en lograr un nivel óptimo de eficiencia en la solución de incidencias.



TUS TAREAS: 



Garantizar que su equipo resuelva las incidencias que se presenten, demostrando en todo momento la proactividad, eficiencia y vocación de servicio necesarias para revertir una experiencia negativa del cliente.

Impulsar la reducción de incidencias mediante el diseño e implementación de estrategias que disminuyan la posibilidad de errores operativos o administrativos que afecten la puntualidad de las entregas y la integridad de los envíos.
Mantener un equipo de trabajo motivado y empoderado para brindar una ejecución de excelencia en el servicio.
Fomentar un ambiente de sinergia y colaboración entre equipos dentro y fuera del área, facilitando el logro de los objetivos de DHL mediante la participación activa de otras áreas en la solución de incidencias.

Identificar las causas raíz de las incidencias, diseñando y proponiendo planes de acción enfocados en eliminarlas, con el objetivo de incrementar la rentabilidad de la operación.

About the job

About the Team

The Campaign Operations team's mission is to deliver high-quality, relevant communications that meet the needs of our customers around the world. We build, test, and launch the retention marketing campaigns designed by our Lifecycle Marketing partners, and we're focused on getting every campaign to the right audience on time and with strong craft. We're growing our team of technical CRM specialists in Mexico City to support that mission.

About the Role

As an Associate, Campaign Operations, you will help build, test, and launch retention marketing campaigns using our email service platform (ESP), Braze, working from designs created by our Lifecycle Marketing partners. You'll support the Campaign Operations Manager and our Lifecycle Marketing partners to help each campaign clear quality review and reach customers on time. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor execution and quality-review role, distinct from brand, content, social media, or performance-marketing positions, and a strong fit for someone early in their CRM or lifecycle-marketing career. This role will report to the Campaign Ops Manager who sits in Mexico City.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Help build, test, and launch retention marketing campaigns across email, push notification, and in-app channels using Braze and our internal tools.
Support the quality-review process for each campaign, working with designers and copywriters and helping build the audience segments each campaign needs.
Partner with our Lifecycle Marketing, Martech, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Design teams on campaign goals and creative execution.
Help monitor campaign performance and share ideas that improve quality, craft, and efficiency for future campaigns.
Grow your CRM and campaign-operations skills by learning our internal marketing tools in depth and taking on more ownership over time.


We're excited about you because…


1+ years of experience in marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing, or equivalent experience such as an internship, coursework, or independent projects. 
Exposure to or experience with an email or marketing automation platform, such as Braze, Iterable, Mailchimp, HubSpot, or Klaviyo. 
Experience or coursework supporting quality checks or testing for a project, campaign, or piece of content. 
Comfort working with data such as open rate, click-through rate, or campaign results to inform decisions.


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

About the job

Want to help pets live their best lives?

We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.

Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


 Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do. 
 Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through district experiences, products, and services. 
 Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success. 


About Petco

We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.
